title: BAI Releases Eligibility Criteria for World Junior Championships 2026 Selection
indian_angle: This circular outlines the specific criteria Indian junior players must meet to be considered for selection to represent India at the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued a circular detailing the eligibility requirements for players aspiring to participate in the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament Postponed, Bhubaneswar Declared WJC Selection Event
indian_angle: This change directly affects Indian U-19 players vying for a spot in the World Junior Championships team, as the selection tournament has been shifted to Bhubaneswar.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the postponement of the Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament and designated the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament as the official selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This marks a major change in scoring format for all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India, impacting young Indian players' game strategy.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament Concludes in Chennai
indian_angle: This was a key domestic tournament for senior Indian players, providing crucial ranking points and competition experience.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026, held in Chennai from July 16th to 23rd, has successfully concluded, featuring top Indian senior players.

title: Grassroot Coaches Development Programs Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: These programs are vital for enhancing the skills of Indian badminton coaches at the grassroots level, directly impacting future talent development across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted Coaches Development Programs at the grassroots level in NCE Guwahati and Raipur from July 15th to 24th, aiming to uplift coaching standards.

title: BAI Invites EOI for Hosting BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: India is actively exploring the possibility of hosting the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, which would be a monumental event for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued an Expression of Interest for potentially hosting the BWF World Championships in 2026, signaling India's ambition to stage a major international badminton event.
